command: Caenorhabditis elegans EAT-3 has microtubule localization/binding (PTN000170013) or participates in peroxisome fission (PTN008520527). Evaluate exact target lineage and whether targeting, mature membrane topology, processing/isoforms, sequence or direct functional assays establish loss or retain these ancestral capacities alongside mitochondrial inner-membrane fusion. Assess the three terms independently. Primary mitochondrial localization and absent worm-specific tests alone do not refute a considered ancestral IBD. Do not equate absence of a shared organelle phenotype with proof of no conditional physical interaction.
